description: Give every arm of the generated benchmark runner the same token budget and have each per_method entry report its own max_new_tokens.
preconditions: Explicit grouped production-write and service-restart authorization is recorded for this batch.
R8 snapshot shows zero active Deepgraph experiment runs, attempt reservations, queued/running GPU jobs, and Colab requests.
A PostgreSQL custom-format backup and the OPERATORS.log predeployment snapshot are recorded before services stop.
Live agents/experiment_forge.py matches the previously deployed commit 15f394d; a mismatch means another session wrote the tree and the deploy stops.
Unrelated GPU workloads on the two A100 hosts are not stopped or modified.
deployment_steps: Stop deepgraph-auto-advance.timer AND deepgraph-auto-advance.service, and deepgraph-auto-execute.service, only after R8 is zero.
Apply batch 1 through scripts/deploy_manifest_batch.py and verify the deployed SHA256.
py_compile the module in the live tree.
Restart auto-execute, then the auto-advance timer.
Append every production action, backup path, checksum, restart and health result to OPERATORS.log.
After restart, make no manual business-state calls; the retry must happen autonomously.
tests: Full suite 72 failed / 818 passed / 18 skipped / 3 collection errors, identical to baseline; static/scope/sql audits passed.

rollback.order: stop services after R8 zero, then reverse batch 1
steps: Use deploy_manifest_batch.py --rollback for 1-equal-budget-template; the restored file must match its recorded predeployment SHA256.
No schema change, no .env change, and no systemd unit change is part of this batch, so nothing else needs reversing.
Restart deepgraph-web.service, the observers, and deepgraph-auto-execute.service, then enable/start deepgraph-auto-advance.timer.
Record rollback commands, restored hashes, service states, and health results in OPERATORS.log.
rollback.data_impact: No schema change and no business-table write. Rolling back restores the 160/48 split, which the deployed comparison-validity gate rejects, so every template-generated run would then be withheld as an invalid comparison.

batches.purpose: Deploy the equal-budget generated runner at R8 zero so forged experiments can pass the comparison-validity gate.
batches.health_check: Re-hash the deployed target, py_compile it, confirm a newly forged train.py contains MAX_NEW_TOKENS and no 160/48 split.
batches.acceptance: Every deployed SHA256 equals this manifest; no live attempt or GPU job crosses the deployment boundary.
